Text to Prompt prepares three separate worker windows automatically using the active project’s Image / Video GPT URL. Custom GPTs use regular chat and their current model. The manual ChatGPT tools here use standard Chat / Temporary Chat; Prepare 3 windows is optional for those tools. JSON → SRT has one separate worker using Work / regular chat with its own model. The three text tabs can process your batch continuously while SRT runs. A failed mode check stops the worker before sending.

Batch queue

Up to 200 prompts per batch. Results are saved before tabs are reused. A retry creates a new job and may repeat a request that already ran on ChatGPT.
